site.name: ScriptureTips
site.tagline: Study the scriptures in the translation you trust.

reader.title: {passage} ({translation})
reader.noVerses: This passage isn't in this translation.
reader.additional: Additional writings: not counted as scripture in the {canon} canon.
reader.varies: Counted as scripture in some traditions, not in others.
reader.noCanonSignedOut: Sign in and choose your canon to see the books in your tradition's order.
reader.noCanon: Choose your canon on your account page to see the books in your tradition's order.

errors.unknown-book: We couldn't find a book by that name.
errors.no-book: Start with the name of a book, e.g. John 3:16.
errors.book-not-in-scheme: This translation doesn't include that book.
errors.expected-chapter: Add a chapter number, e.g. John 3.
errors.no-such-chapter: That book doesn't have a chapter with that number.
errors.no-such-verse: That chapter doesn't have a verse with that number.
errors.verse-counts-unknown: We can't read that passage in this translation yet.
errors.backwards-range: The passage ends before it starts.
errors.unexpected-text: We couldn't read part of that reference.
errors.too-many-verses: That's more than we show at once. Try a chapter or a few chapters.
errors.unavailable: Scripture text isn't available right now. Please try again shortly.

account.signInIntro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a code to sign in with. There's no password. If you're new, this creates your account.
account.codeSent: We've sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works once, within the next 10 minutes.
account.title: Your account
account.welcome: Welcome to ScriptureTips. Choose a handle, a display name and your canon to finish setting up your account.
account.emailPrivate: Signed in as {email}. Your email address is never shown to other people.
account.handleHelp: Your name in links, e.g. /@{example}. Letters, numbers and hyphens, 3 to 30 characters. For now it can't be changed once chosen.
account.name: Display name
account.nameHelp: How your name is shown to others. Any language or script.
account.canonHelp: Which books you count as scripture. Books outside it are still there, labelled as additional writings. You can change this at any time.

accountErrors.bot-check-pending: Please wait for the check to finish, or tick the box.
accountErrors.bot-check-failed: The check didn't pass. Please try again.
accountErrors.too-many-codes: We've sent several codes to this address already. Please wait an hour before asking for another.
accountErrors.rate-limited: Too many attempts from your connection. Please wait a little and try again.
accountErrors.wrong-code: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
accountErrors.code-expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
accountErrors.too-many-attempts: That code has had too many wrong attempts. Ask for a new one.
accountErrors.handle-taken: That handle is taken. Try another.
accountErrors.handle-reserved: That handle is reserved. Try another.
accountErrors.handle-invalid: Use 3 to 30 letters, numbers or hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.
accountErrors.name-invalid: Enter a display name of up to 60 characters.
accountErrors.name-reserved: That name is reserved. Try another.
accountErrors.unavailable: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.

canons.protestantHelp: 66 books. The Apocrypha is shown as additional writings.
canons.catholicHelp: 73 books, with Tobit, Judith, 1 and 2 Maccabees, Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch and the Greek parts of Esther and Daniel.
canons.orthodoxHelp: 76 books, the Greek Orthodox canon: the Catholic books with 1 Esdras, 3 Maccabees and Psalm 151.

compilations.title: Your compilations
compilations.intro: A compilation is your own translation. Start from a base translation, then take books, chapters or passages from others. It stays private to you.
compilations.none: You haven't made a compilation yet.
compilations.needHandle: Choose a handle on your account page first: your compilations' links use it.
compilations.abbreviationHelp: 2 to 12 letters or numbers. It's part of your compilation's link.
compilations.baseHelp: Every verse comes from here unless you choose another source.
compilations.narrower: {count, plural, one {and # passage from elsewhere} other {and # passages from elsewhere}}
compilations.passageHelp: E.g. Genesis, Psalm 23 or Isaiah 53:1–12, in your compilation's numbering. A single verse comes later.

compilationErrors.handle-required: Choose a handle on your account page first.
compilationErrors.base-not-allowed: That translation's licence doesn't allow it to be a base.
compilationErrors.source-not-allowed: That translation's licence doesn't allow taking its verses.
compilationErrors.name-of-translation: That's the name of a published translation. Choose your own, so readers aren't misled.
compilationErrors.abbreviation-taken: You already have a compilation with that abbreviation.
compilationErrors.one-reference: Enter one book, chapter or passage at a time.
compilationErrors.no-canonical: We can't place that passage in other translations yet.
compilationErrors.single-verse: Choose at least two verses. Choosing single verses comes later.
compilationErrors.not-in-base: Your base translation has no verses there. Books it lacks come later.
compilationErrors.rule-overlaps: That overlaps a choice you've already made. Remove that one first, or choose a narrower passage.
compilationErrors.invalid-request: Check what you entered and try again.
compilationErrors.unavailable: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
